title: Extremely frustrated
body: I purchased the pro version, payment deducted from my bank. Payment has reached the merchant (confirmed by bank) and yet there is no update on my subscription. I am still using the limited version. Customer service is non existent. These people are SCAMMERS. I am calling you out on my social media platforms next if you don't return my money NOW. I have filed a chargeback.
author: Dr. Falak Joshipura
